greeting: Hello! I can help you set, view or cancel medicine reminders.
help:
Add a reminder, view reminders or cancel a reminder.
I only handle medicine reminders. Check the details before saving.
Use a quoted medicine name, an exact time and daily repetition. Review before saving.
remind me to take "My medicine" at 8 PM daily
show my reminders
cancel "My medicine"
out_of_scope: I'm only able to help with medicine reminders, not medical advice. Please check with your doctor or pharmacist for that.
add_reminder_missing_medicine: I couldn't catch which medicine. Could you say the medicine name again?
no_reminders: You have no active reminders right now.
cancelled: Done, that reminder has been cancelled.
cancel_not_found: I couldn't find a matching reminder to cancel.
unsupported: This language is not supported yet.
missing_time: Time is missing. Enter an explicit time with AM or PM.
time_ambiguous: Choose the intended time, or correct the sentence.
frequency: Recurrence is unclear or unsupported. Correct the sentence with daily or named weekdays.
date: A specific date cannot be saved by Talk in this version. Enter an explicit daily recurrence only if that is what you intend; no one-off request will be converted automatically.
dosage: Dosage instructions need manual review. Use the form and follow your prescription; no dose was inferred.
view_reminders: Select a reminder in Medicines to review its full details before deletion.
cancel_review: Select a reminder in Medicines to review its full details before deletion.
